Definition: physical (as shutting in) a net (either literally or figuratively); usually a doomed object; abstractly extermination
BiblicalUsage: 1) a thing devoted, thing dedicated, ban, devotion; 2) a net, thing perforated; 3) have been utterly destroyed, (appointed to) utter destruction
